entrypoints.name: decode
entrypoints.domain: Run-length code lists generated by the source-referenced encoder; the provided statement does not define behavior for manually constructed non-positive Many counts.
entrypoints.semantics: Concatenate, in input order, one x for each One x and n consecutive x values for each Many (n, x). Preserve exact sequence order and multiplicity.
